entries.text: The moment a dragon, with its\npiercing gaze, spits fire at you.
This guy comes spinning at you at top speed,\ntrying to knock you down. So be quick\nwith that shutter finger of yours!
They've got big bellies, but they've\nalso got the fastest legs you ever did see.\nJust catch one of them on film, buddy.
Those Memo-Eaters are hard to find.\nAnd they never travel together.\nHow's that for a scoop?
The moment that cute Dog Statue\nchanges its shape, you click that\nshutter.
When that Bone Lord goes unconscious,\nwatch him, 'cause his eyes go googley.\nTake the shot then.
This one thinks it's a ballerina.\nSnap it the moment it does its\nspinning attack.
When it's swinging its weapon,\nPumpkinhead's a dangerous one.\nCatch it in the act, kid.
An attack by a Golem. Get it the\nsecond one raises up both arms.\nTemperamental buggers, aren't they?
This one's the best.\nPriest of Rama likes his massages.\nWatch for the funniest part.
Right when Gyumo's screaming.\nMaybe, it's trying to intimidate everyone.\nGet this moment on film.
Man-Eating Grass has a creepy smile.\nLooks like it's eating something.\nThat's when you get the shot.
Watch for the moment Linda stomps down on\nyou with her front foot. It might be\na little scary, but you can do it.
Catch that horrifying moment when the\nClown Robo launches its missiles. But\nwatch out 'cause you won't have much time!
You probably want to get a shot of\nthe butterfly fused back together.\nThat'd make a much better picture.
Catch Shingala being controlled\nin the heat of battle.\nIt's quite the sight...
Gaspard can change his appearance\nusing Griffon's magic.\nGet a shot of that!
Get a shot of Baron Balloon\nbeing flipped over by a Vanguard\nduring a Trample Attack!
Tore may be a big bulky beast, but\nit sure does like its naps. Sneak\nin and snap it then!
Those Masked Tribesman fall flat on their\nbacks. Get in there and snap one of their\nsilly faces behind their mask shields.
They're always moving around underground.\nCatch one of them Molers up in the air\na rare sight indeed.
This one might be a little tough.\nYou need to get a shot of this thing\nwhen it comes after you and self-destructs.
There's a guy who says he saw\nFlotsam in Zelmite Mine.\nIf it's true it'd be a real scoop!
They say there's a really strong\nboss who revived Flotsam.\nIf you find him, don't let him get away.
Emperor Griffon, master of darkness\nIt'd certainly be a scoop to get one\nof him.
Get a shot of Jaming in action,\npulling the Shiguras' strings.
Go for a shot of that fantastic\nshiny golden egg at Jurak Mall\nin the future.
Grab a shot of Jurak, the\nresurrected Elder of the\nForest Spirits.
You know that big crystal in the\nmiddle of Starlight Temple?\nGet a shot of that.
Look for the Luna Lab emblem\nup above the Central Lab.
Try for a shot of the aerial\nfortress, Paznos.
Aim for Master Utan when it's\nin pain from eating the Forbidden Fruit.
Try and get a shot of the sun\nsinking behind the horizon\noff the Veniccio coast.
Grab a nice shot of the mural of\nthe imaginary world of the\n"Moon of Destruction".
It's the peculiar giant fish from\nFish Monster Swamp. It may be a little\ngross, but I know you can handle it.
The impossibly big Lafrescia.\nCatch its fully grown stem\nfor a great shot.
Try pointin' your camera at\nthe Death Ark, the flying warship.
The fearsome device Fire Squall\nthat rains fire on Heim Rada.\nGo get a shot of that!
The superexpress that flies\nthrough time and space!\nGet a picture of Ixion!
It's said that the moon will fall out of\nthe sky. Naturally if that were to happen\nyou wouldn't miss getting a shot of it.
It's the castle where Griffon is.\nReal fancy place. Get a shot of the\nentrance as proof you were there.
Check out the three altars\nin the centre of Kazarov Stonehenge.
Get a shot of the rebel army's mobile\nbase, Paznos, from Kazarov Stonehenge.
Get a shot of the Earth Gem Altar in\nRainbow Butterfly Wood.
Get a shot of the Wind Gem Altar at\nStella Canyon.
Get a shot of the Water Gem Altar in\nOcean's Roar Cave.
Get a shot of the Fire Gem Altar at\nMt. Gundor.
Get a shot of the bronze statue\nin front of the Sun Gate.
Get a picture of a Sun Flower from\nthe Flower Garden or Alexandra's\nroom.
What would happen if you blew the legendary\nFire Horn? Who knows? But make sure you\nhave your camera at the ready!
Go get a shot of the light at the\nextraction point in the Zelmite\nmine. Easy enough for ya?
Get a nice shot of the site where\nthat Death Ark crashed!
It's kind of like a haunted picture,\nthat white haze around Palm Brinks Park...
A warrior who died long ago in Veniccio\nroams around night after night.\nWhat? You scared?
I've heard Heim Rada is\na bit of a spot for ghosts.\nDon't worry. You won't be cursed.
